_note: Network profile switch (SPEC 14.10): the one place that says which network and which deployment. Every service (Core, indexer, runtime, the web server) and the pages (through /chain/config, and packages/chain/src/default-profile.ts before it answers) read it. `network` is the default, mainnet; UNITS_NETWORK overrides it for one process (UNITS_NETWORK=devnet selects devnet; the devnet site's env file pins it). `mainnet_deployment` says which deployment the mainnet profile describes, and is the ONE edit that moves the default to the official deployment: `profiles.mainnet` below is written for the OFFICIAL deployment (the launch's program ids 3GeaTs..., 2vwKsT..., jmcb7c..., which are NOT deployed yet, and the official quote), and `mainnet_deployments` maps each name to the overlay file laid over that block, or null for the block as written. Today it is "test": config/mainnet-test/profile.json (the mainnet TEST deployment that exists on chain: its program ids, its quote coin shown as UNITS, its state file, swap off). Once the official programs are deployed and initialized, set `mainnet_deployment` to "official" (UNITS_MAINNET_DEPLOYMENT overrides it for one process; UNITS_PROFILE_LOCAL names a server instance's own overlay and then is the only overlay). mainnet: no faucet, no TEST labels, a keyed RPC from UNITS_MAINNET_RPC (environment or ~/.config/units/rpc.env; never printed, never sent to a browser, no public fallback, never a fall back to devnet), priority fees from getRecentPrioritizationFees capped below. The official quote: $UNITS does not exist on mainnet yet, so profiles.mainnet quote.mint is a stand-in (PYUSD, the same mint as config/swap.json target_mint). quote.units_mint is the official $UNITS mint the owner named on 2026-10-12, GQdEL4...Hpump, with units_mint_status reserved: a pre-generated pump.fun address that is NOT created yet (no account on mainnet on 2026-10-12), so nothing uses it; `bun scripts/mainnet/units-mint-check.ts` prints its state. Only once it exists as a pump.fun coin paired with SOL or USDC, never mayhem mode, does the owner set quote.mint to it, quote.status to live and units_mint_status to live. No USD price feed is wired here: usd_feed null.
